assertions.subject: FFI
assertions.quote: Sleep disturbance: Patients can initially present with insomnia

assertions.subject: FFI
assertions.quote: Autonomic dysfunction: The patient may present with varying degrees of autonomic dysfunction

assertions.subject: FFI
assertions.quote: Neurological impairments: Due to the joint involvement of the brainstem, multiple cranial nerves can be affected

assertions.subject: FFI
assertions.quote: Mental health disease: Behavioral and intellectual capacity remains largely intact even in the late stages

assertions.subject: FFI
assertions.quote: Systemic and endocrine changes: Progressive frailty and weight loss are seen in most patients

assertions.subject: FFI
assertions.quote: Organic sleep disturbances, including intractable insomnia, agrypnia excitata with or without laryngeal stridor, sleep apnea, or involuntary movements

assertions.subject: FFI
assertions.quote: Neurologic and mental health impairment, including rapidly progressive dementia, ataxia, myoclonus, hallucination, delusion, or personality changes

assertions.subject: FFI
assertions.quote: Progressive autonomic and systemic abnormalities, including hypertension, tachycardia, irregular breathing, hyperthermia, sweating, or weight loss >10 kg during the last 6 months
